held_out_policy: 1024 examples used once for final comparison after policy lock; no threshold/configuration selection
public_policy: no training, calibration, or policy selection
primary_objective: prior-weighted normalized Exact Match, conservative proxy for professor exact-match/correct-null credit
secondary_objective: prior-weighted F1 (partial-overlap proxy; actual LLM judge unavailable)
candidate_scope: diagnose current spans/logits/windows, then change abstention threshold only unless a reproducible extraction defect is found
tie_break: secondary objective, then closest to original threshold
